title: Close-area any-angle planning: Theta* and Lazy Theta* against A* + shortcut on 8 arena families, known and unknown map
summary: Own pure-Python Theta* (Daniel, Nash, Koenig, Felner 2010) and Lazy Theta* (Nash, Koenig, Tovey 2010) on the close-area arena's inflated 0.1 m grid with the same ESDF clearance cost as planners/astar_esdf: the any-angle edge parent(u) => v is priced by the A* cell cost integrated along the segment and must not touch a blocked cell, so the clearance cost still shapes the path. Exact uniform-cost-disc speed-up (checked equal to the plain walk on 80 searches). The flying planner subclasses AStarESDF (same two inflation levels, replan schedule, log-odds map, carrot follower and speed law) and drops only the post-hoc shortcut. make() works with no arguments; make(lazy=True); make(known_map=False, bounds=...) uses the benchmark's geofenced map. bench.py flights reuses close-area-benchmark's run_one for 8 families x 20 layouts on preset ideal (known and unknown map) plus crazyflie on random and office; its A* rows equal the benchmark matrix run by run. bench.py plans: single-process planning-only comparison (ms, length, cost, exact clearance). numpy + scipy only. Synthetic arena only.
verified: ran 2026-11-10 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 on Apple silicon arm64 (16 CPUs, shared with other jobs, 1-minute load average 38-256 recorded in each results file), in the sample venv (requirements.txt reuses the arena's): bench.py flights --layouts 20 --seed 0 --workers 14 (1080 runs, wall 781.5 s) wrote results/flights_0.*; bench.py plans --layouts 20 --seed 0 --repeats 3 (wall 123 s) wrote results/plans_0.*; a single-process unknown-map timing run (1 layout per family, wall 296.3 s) wrote results/timing_unknown_jobs1.*; bench.py check wrote results/matrix_check_0.md (A* rows identical to close-area-benchmark/results/matrix_0.json: 160/160 known, 160/160 unknown, 40/40 crazyflie). The uniform-disc speed-up returned identical paths and costs to the plain line walk on 80 searches (ad hoc check, not saved to results/). Every number in README is from results/ or the cited abstracts. test_smoke.py: 1 passed in the venv, 1 skipped under plain python3 3.14 without numpy. No file outside this folder was edited. Not run in Pyodide; replan ms are wall time under machine load. Layouts, vehicle and sensor are simulated; no SITL, no flight.
shows: Theta* and Lazy Theta* vs A* + shortcut on the same grid and cost: paired time to B, flown length and clearance on 8 families (known and unknown map, two sensor presets), planning ms per replan against a 200 ms budget
runtime: plans ~2 min (1 process); flights ~13 min on 14 processes; unknown-map timing ~5 min
key_result: [20 layouts x 8 families, seed 0](README.md#headline-faster-flights-slightly-longer-paths-35-55x-the-planning-time): Theta* reached B sooner than A* + shortcut in 157/160 known-map layouts (median 6-34 % less time per family) with 0.5-7 % longer paths and the same 100 % reached; plan median 118 ms (Lazy 73 ms) vs A* 18 ms; unknown map p95 1.88 s (Lazy 0.39 s) FAILS the 200 ms budget; 4-beam office collisions 25 % => 60 % (Lazy 35 %)

readiness.limitation: Synthetic 2.5D point-mass arena on one shared Apple silicon machine; setup needs PyPI wheels (time not measured); offline not checked; Pyodide not run; Linux not tested.
